::: {#exm-ols-slr}
#### OLS estimates of a simple linear regression

For a simple linear regression,
the OLS estimates (@def-ols) $\hintcoef$ and $\hcoef{x}$
are the values of $\intcoef$ and $\coef{x}$
that minimize $\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ from @exm-rss-slr.
@fig-rss-surface shows $\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$
for the three points of @exm-rss:
the OLS estimates sit at the bottom of the bowl,
and the line of @exm-rss sits higher up.

::: {#fig-rss-surface}

```{r}
rss_grid <- expand.grid(
  b0 = seq(0, 2.5, length.out = 101),
  bx = seq(-0.5, 1.5, length.out = 101)
)
rss_grid$rss <- mapply(
  function(b0, bx) sum((rss_points$y - b0 - bx * rss_points$x)^2),
  rss_grid$b0,
  rss_grid$bx
)
ols_coefs <- coef(lm(y ~ x, data = rss_points))

ggplot2::ggplot(rss_grid, ggplot2::aes(x = b0, y = bx, z = rss)) +
  ggplot2::geom_contour(
    ggplot2::aes(color = ggplot2::after_stat(level)),
    breaks = c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8)
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "point",
    x = ols_coefs[[1]], y = ols_coefs[[2]], size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::annotate("point", x = 1, y = 0.5, shape = 4, size = 3) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = expression(beta[0]),
    y = expression(beta[x]),
    color = "RSS"
  )

ols_coefs
```

Contours of $\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ for the three points of @exm-rss.
The dot marks the OLS estimates;
the cross marks the line of @exm-rss.

:::
:::
